## Example 6.4 {#ss6-example-6-4 .gs-lesson }

Find the sixth partial sum of the geometric series $2-6+18-\ldots$.

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 37 · Example 6.4</p>

::: notes


a=2, r=−3, n=6. S_6=2[1−(−3)^6]/[1−(−3)]=2(1−729)/4=−364. Direct check: 2−6+18−54+162−486=−364. Use brackets around the negative ratio. A sum of alternating positive and negative terms can be negative. Do not take the ratio as +3.

:::
